scope: Add the M3 suppression-label checker and definition note (PROP-P3-M3-SUPPRESSION-LABELS-01, NEW DERIVATION / PROPOSAL, not yet in Toledo). Reuse-first: the cancellation ledger PROP-P2-CANCELLATION-LEDGER-01, the general anchor-cross nullity theorem PROP-P3-GENERAL-ANCHOR-CROSS-NULLITY-01, the equal-shell direction lock, the RSC-O two-anchor planarity convention from PR #60, Genesis readout-to-defect soundness, and the W1/W2/W3 fixtures. Per suppressed target the checker returns a label set L(e) subset of {O (ORTH: a.q = 0 or b.p = 0), E (EQSHELL: |p| = |q|), C (MSCANCEL: >= 2 individually nonzero contributions, net exactly zero), T (TED: outside the declared cell)} or UNRESOLVED (fail-closed); labels are not mutually exclusive; C is an accounting label, never a physical loss. Double-O counter: O(e) = retained anchors whose interaction with the recruit is O-suppressed; double-O means rank{a_i : i in O(e)} >= 2, not merely two O labels; N_{O,1} and N_{O,>=2} reported per fixture. Exact results: UNRESOLVED = 0 on W1, W2, W3 point A; W1 k target is C without E; W3 k target is C and E; label counts W1 O8/E8/C2/T8, W2 O12/E12/C2/T12, W3 O16/E26/C2/T16; double-O N_{O,1}/N_{O,>=2} = 8/0, 12/0, 14/2 (W3 double-O targets are +-k). The orthogonal-turn generation-1 chain fixture is omitted because that checker registers no exact amplitude vectors. This is a labeling / accounting instrument only: it proves nothing about OCSR, Witness Soundness, RSC-O/E/C, G6/G7, global cancellation compatibility, or Clay Navier-Stokes regularity, all of which remain OPEN. No prior statement is refuted; no global P2 claim is promoted. Merged over main (#61 O1 wording correction: the Delta_P fixed-line classification of the two A1 papers is declared over the real fixture field GL(2,R)/RP^1, the elliptic case does not exclude complex Type-P recurrence, lane T0-04 named; no status/tier change). The M3 label checker does not depend on that classification; all global items remain OPEN.
